criteria.description: Exact runnable supported action, role and expected output; no roadmap capability presented as implemented.
Traceable repository/revision/path evidence; runtime versus source-only claims correctly distinguished.
Observable goal, complete prerequisites, sequenced actions, expected result, realistic recovery and independent practice.
Owner/reviewer/date metadata, complete JSON ledger and mappings, mandatory review limits explicit.
No personal/confidential inputs sent to unapproved tools; offline path and asset inventory supported.
Stable glossary and segment IDs, source labels retained, missing translation reviews explicit.
